title: Red Cow
description: the ability to craft the energy drink, Red Cow, which gives you a massive boost, but has a chance of spontaneous death via heart attack.
body:
**This mod adds three new energy drinks, RedCow, Mob Energy, and Fahrenheit.**
These drinks are fully craftable in survival, and each provide their own unique effects.

there is one drawback though, drink too many and you risk a heart attack.
